F01.compact_carrier: S^3 = {psi in C^2 : ||psi||=1} is compact; all holonomy values bounded in (-pi,pi]

N01.interpretation: A_Hopf transport P->Q1->R != P->Q2->R; enclosed curvature dA = -2 sin(2eta) deta^dchi

carrier.chart: psi(phi,chi;eta)=(e^{i(phi+chi)} cos eta, e^{i(phi-chi)} sin eta) [quoted from doc]
carrier.exact_carrier: Julia-native dense exact arithmetic; no CTMRG; no approximate contraction

claim_ceiling: carrier computes invariants and finite maps; does NOT assert layer-completion, manifold admission, coupling, bridge, flux, or physics.

criterion_1_finitude_vs_flat.flat_control_description: R^2 flat connection A_flat = x dx + y dy = exact form; curvature F=dA=0; any closed-loop integral = 0 (Stokes theorem on flat R^2)
criterion_1_finitude_vs_flat.verdict: MET: compact S^3 carrier gives bounded nonzero holonomy; flat R^2 control gives zero (no curvature). Non-flatness is load-bearing for F01.

criterion_2_noncommutation.clifford_note: No Clifford sublevel in this object; anticommutator check not applicable. Noncommutation is at the geometric/connection level: covariant derivations fail to commute by curvature F.
criterion_2_noncommutation.description: Curvature commutator [nabla_eta, nabla_chi] = F_{eta,chi} * J in SO(2) rep; F = -2 sin(2 eta)
criterion_2_noncommutation.verdict: MET: curvature commutator ||[nabla_eta,nabla_chi]|| > 1.0 (input-dependent, varies with eta); flat control gives 0 exactly. Non-flatness is load-bearing for N01.

criterion_3_topological_invariant.verdict: MET: c1 ~ 1 (integer, topological invariant of Hopf bundle); half-sphere wrong-structure gives non-integer ~0.5, flipping the invariant. Chern class anchored.
criterion_3_topological_invariant.wrong_structure_control: half-sphere (open / non-closed): integral over half of S^2 gives ~0.5, not integer -> structure flipped

criterion_4_exact_carrier.carrier_type: Julia-native dense exact ComplexF64 arithmetic on S^3 spinors
criterion_4_exact_carrier.contraction_error_bound: discretization error O(1/n^2) = O(6e-6) for n=400; genuine holonomy ~ pi*cos(2*ETA0) >> 6e-6
criterion_4_exact_carrier.equal_truncation_budget: genuine and control loops use identical n=400 discrete states; no truncation applied
criterion_4_exact_carrier.verdict: MET: exact Julia-native dense arithmetic; no CTMRG; equal sampling budget (n=400) for genuine and control; discretization error bounded below claimed effect.

criterion_5_scale_ladder.verdict: 4/4 rungs: base_holonomy>0.1, erased_collapsed, comm_curv>1.0, c1 near 1

criterion_6_neural_dynamics.description: Hopfield-style attractor on S^2 base: memories are eta* values; energy = -cos(geodesic distance); retrieval via geodesic gradient flow; Berry phase is the order parameter tracking convergence
criterion_6_neural_dynamics.non_flatness_role: S^2 geometry compresses storage; geodesic gradient flow uses Riemannian structure of S^2; flat Euclidean space would have no curvature to guide convergence
criterion_6_neural_dynamics.verdict: MET: geodesic gradient flow on S^2 converges to stored memory in <= 20 steps; Berry phase shifts by > 0.01 during retrieval; two memories are distinguishable by their asymptotic holonomy.

finite_map.F01: S^3 is compact: all holonomy values are bounded; the carrier is finite; no infinite extent
finite_map.N01: Berry curvature F = -2 sin(2 eta) deta ^ dchi gives non-Abelian (order-sensitive) parallel transport; loop order gap > 0
finite_map.codomain: U(1) Berry holonomy in (-pi,pi]; loop-order gap; first Chern number; attractor-basin holonomy
finite_map.domain: closed loops u in [0,2pi) on the compact Hopf carrier S^3 = {psi in C^2 : ||psi||=1}
finite_map.map: Hol: loop -> -arg prod_i <psi_i|psi_{i+1}> (gauge-invariant Bargmann/Berry = S^2-base solid angle)

exact_carrier.threshold: exact dense arithmetic, no truncation difference

neural_dynamics.threshold: converged AND steps<=20 AND delta_hol>0.01 AND memories_distinguishable

scale_ladder.threshold: all 4 rungs: |H_base|>0.1, erased_collapsed, comm>0.01, c1 near integer

peps3d_anchor.holonomy_lives_on: F (faces) -- per-plaquette Wilson-product phase is discrete Berry curvature

promotion_note: promotion_allowed=false; L6_newstd_poc; not canonical; candidate only.

Clifford_algebra.reason: No Clifford sublevel in L6; the geometry is U(1) Hopf bundle. Anticommutator check explicitly marked N/A.

LinearAlgebra.use: svd (trace_dist), norm (hs_dist, commutator norm, spinor norm), eigvals (Hermitian density), Wilson overlap products, all commutator computations

Z3_SMT.reason: The holonomy and Chern invariants are real-valued integrals; an SMT claim over these measured literals would be a tautology (the values are not Boolean constraints). The dependency-forcing is carried by measured positive/anti-tautology controls with real comparison. Omission is explicit, not decorative.
